author: Top Gear
description:
In this video Top Gear drives a prototype version of the new Lamborghini Urus SE Performante. It’s the fastest (3.3sec to 62mph, 194mph top speed) and most powerful (812hp) ICE SUV in the world, and comes with trick suspension, a titanium exhaust,  carbonfibre and downforce aplenty, and a new Rally mode. Think of it as an SVJ-style Lamborghini Urus!

🚗 Lamborghini Urus SE Performante (prototype)
